subject: Request: Egress evidence pack, IP custody, and firewall snapshot
body:
From: security@novacorp.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@novacorp.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Egress evidence request for Private Endpoint onboarding (NovaCorp)

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. For our internal compliance gate we need an evidence package for the Redwood private endpoint that NovaCorp will connect to. Can you provide the following items by COB Aug 6: 

- Definitive list of egress IP addresses (control plane + runtime) currently used by the Private deployment and an assertion of whether those IPs are stable or ephemeral.
- Firewall rule snapshot (export) showing outbound rules Redwood expects from our VPC to your control plane and runtime endpoints.
- A mapping of services/FQDNs and ports (including SNI patterns) required for successful operation (for example: control.redwood-inference.com:443, telemetry.redwood-inference.com:443).
- Any proxying/transparent TLS interception guidance (do you require mTLS to upstream proxies?).
- A short statement on IP ownership / custody (do you own the IPs or are they cloud-provider owned ephemeral ranges?).
- Signed attestation (PDF) that the artifacts reflect production routing as of the date provided.

We prefer a single zip with artifacts and a CSV inventory. If any of this requires an NDA or additional paperwork, please flag it.

Appreciate it,

Mina Patel
Senior Information Security Analyst
NovaCorp
security@novacorp.com

-----
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: security@novacorp.com
Cc: david_kim@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Egress evidence request for Private Endpoint onboarding (NovaCorp)

Mina —

Thanks for the clear list. We can assemble an evidence pack. A few quick clarifying items so we scope this correctly: 

1) When you say control plane + runtime IPs, do you need historically rotated ephemeral ranges (last 90 days) or only the current advertised/currently-in-use addresses? Our normal offering provides a current snapshot and a 90-day rotation log on request for SOC packages.

2) For signed attestation, we can provide a Redwood operations attestation PDF (signed by our Head of Ops). Is that acceptable or do you require notarization?

3) Do you need the raw iptables/ACL exports from the gateway (we typically provide a firewall-snapshot.txt that lists the expected CIDR/port matrix), or just a human-readable rule set?

I'll coordinate the artifacts with David (ops) for the runtime/control-plane outputs and Marissa for any contract/attestation paperwork.

Best,

Irene Choi
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

-----
From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Egress evidence request for Private Endpoint onboarding (NovaCorp)

Irene / Mina / Marissa —

Putting in the ops notes here so Mina has a preview before we assemble the zip: 

- Current published egress addresses: 52.216.10.0/24 (control-plane), 52.216.11.0/25 (runtime-1), 54.210.200.32 (ephemeral-proxy-1). We mark control-plane as stable (we own the allocation via our ASN and update with 30d notice); runtime ranges are subject to autoscaler reallocation but we also offer static reserved pools under Dedicated.

- Rotation policy: default ephemeral pools rotate every 14–30 days; we keep a 90-day ledger that maps allocation changes (we can include the ledger CSV).

- Ports/FQDNs required: 
  * control.redwood-inference.com:443 (control plane API, mTLS optional but recommended)
  * runtime-<region>.redwood-inference.com:443 (model serving; SNI-based routing)
  * telemetry.redwood-inference.com:443 (TLS, outgoing metrics/alerts to our collector)
  * s3-us-east-1.amazonaws.com:443 (artifact retrieval; happens from runtime for some models)
  * ntp.pool.org:123 (optional; time sync)

- Proxying/mTLS: We support mutual TLS on the control plane for customers that require TLS client auth. In most default installs we rely on standard TLS with validated SNI and certificate pinning for internal components. If NovaCorp has an intercepting proxy, we can operate behind it but require that the proxy preserves SNI headers and supports TLS 1.2+ without modifying client certs (unless you configure mTLS and we exchange client certs).

- Firewall snapshot: I will export the current iptables ruleset and generate a sanitized firewall-snapshot-20270805.txt (will remove internal hostnames and kept only the CIDR/port mapping).

Planned artifacts to include in the zip: egress-evidence-2027-08.zip (contains ip-inventory-202707.csv, firewall-snapshot-20270805.txt, rotation-ledger-202705-202708.csv, ops-attestation.pdf).

If Nova prefers a CSV template, attach here: ip-inventory-202707.csv (columns: ip, cidr, role, stable_true_false, first_seen, last_seen, note).

Let me know if we should include packet captures — those require an elevated request as they contain host identifiers.

-David

David Kim
Principal Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.ai

-----
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: security@novacorp.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Egress evidence request for Private Endpoint onboarding (NovaCorp)

Mina —

Attached is the evidence pack we discussed. Quick notes and explicit statements below. Attachment listing: 
- egress-evidence-2027-08.zip (zip) — master bundle (contains everything listed below)
- ip-inventory-202707.csv (CSV) — authoritative inventory as of 2027-07-31
- firewall-snapshot-20270805.txt (text) — sanitized outbound rule export (CIDR/port matrix)
- ops-attestation.pdf (PDF) — signed by our Head of Ops (electronic signature).

Explicit statements for your compliance record (signed by Redwood Ops included in ops-attestation.pdf):
1) IP ownership: Redwood operates the control-plane CIDR 52.216.10.0/24 under AS64512 (customer-facing announcement). Runtime pools (example shown in CSV) are allocated from cloud provider ranges and are therefore subject to provider-managed reassignment. For Dedicated/reserved customers we can provide a static reserved pool under contract.

2) Egress behavior: outbound traffic originates from runtime nodes; control plane connections are predominantly from the control-plane CIDR. Some orchestration/agent traffic may originate from ephemeral proxies; these are included in the CSV with the "ephemeral" flag.

3) Ports and FQDNs: see the included CSV and snapshot. All services use TLS 1.2+; SNI is required for routing. We recommend opening outbound HTTPS (443) to the listed FQDNs and allowing the CIDR ranges in the CSV if you prefer IP-level allowlisting.

4) Proxy handling: we can support customers with intercepting proxies provided the proxy preserves SNI and does not terminate and re-sign client certs unless mTLS is explicitly configured between Redwood and the proxy. If Nova wants us to present client certs to your proxy (mTLS), we will exchange certificates and document the trust anchors.

5) Evidence freshness & rotation: the snapshot files reflect state as of 2027-08-05 11:00 PDT. We will provide a 90-day rotation ledger on request; the ledger CSV in the zip shows allocation deltas for May–July 2027.

Next steps: please confirm whether you will enforce IP-level allowlisting or if FQDN/SNI-based allowlisting is acceptable. If you need a notarized attestation, advise contact + PO and we will route to legal.

Link to shared folder (internal): https://redwood.example.com/drive/egress-evidence-2027-08

Regards,

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: egress-evidence-2027-08.zip (zip), ip-inventory-202707.csv (csv), firewall-snapshot-20270805.txt (txt), ops-attestation.pdf (pdf)

-----
On Thu, 05 Aug 2027 11:10:00 -0700 security@novacorp.com wrote:

Thanks Marissa — received the bundle and starting our intake. Two quick asks so we can close this through the gate: 
1) Can you add a single-line attestation in the ops-attestation.pdf stating: "As of 2027-08-05, the attached artifacts accurately reflect Redwood Inference production egress behavior for the Private Endpoint assigned to NovaCorp" and include the signer's name, title, and date?
2) Please confirm whether the control-plane CIDR requires inbound rules from NovaCorp or if only outbound allowlisting is needed.

Mina

security@novacorp.com
